name: mission-control
description: Mission Control for OpenClaw - Autonomous agent orchestration and observability
author: Jarrett West

scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n convex,executor,ui -c blue,magenta,green "npx convex dev" "pnpm run dev:workflow-executor" "VITE_FLAG_UI_SHELL_V2=true VITE_FLAG_CONTEXT_REGISTRY=true VITE_FLAG_EOS_COMMAND_CENTER_PREVIEW=true pnpm --filter mission-control-ui exec vite --port 5199 --strictPort"
scripts.dev:demo:ui: VITE_FLAG_UI_SHELL_V2=true VITE_FLAG_CONTEXT_REGISTRY=true VITE_FLAG_EOS_COMMAND_CENTER_PREVIEW=true pnpm --filter mission-control-ui exec vite --port 5199 --strictPort
scripts.dev:workflow-executor: pnpm --filter @mission-control/workflow-engine build && pnpm run workflows:seed && node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx apps/workflow-executor/src/index.ts
scripts.smoke:orchestration-start: pnpm run ci:prepare && pnpm --filter @mission-control/orchestration-server build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/orchestration-server smoke:start
scripts.test: pnpm run ci:prepare && pnpm -r --if-present run test && pnpm exec vitest run convex/__tests__
scripts.test:e2e:critical: npx playwright test -c playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/critical-accessibility.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/dashboard-smoke.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/v2-routes-smoke.e2e.spec.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run ci:prepare && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.convex:seed:demo:full: npx convex run seedMissionControlDemo:run '{"force": true}' && npx convex run seedMemory:run
scripts.ci:prepare: pnpm --filter @mission-control/shared build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/state-machine build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/policy-engine build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/workflow-engine build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/coordinator build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/context-router build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/model-router build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/memory build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/context-tools build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/agent-runtime build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/telegraph build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/meetings build && pnpm --filter @mission-control/research-adapters build
scripts.security:authorization: pnpm exec vitest run scripts/lib/convex-authorization-scan.test.mjs && node scripts/check-convex-authorization.mjs
scripts.release:security: pnpm run security:audit && pnpm run security:authorization && pnpm run security:secrets && pnpm run docs:factory-check
